description: Implementation of the Stream class in the GuzzleHttp PSR7 package, providing a PHP stream abstraction with various methods for stream handling.

classes.name: Stream
classes.description: A class implementing PHP stream handling, providing methods for reading, writing, seeking, and metadata management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a Stream object wrapping a PHP resource stream, with optional size and metadata.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Closes the stream upon object destruction.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the entire stream contents as a string, seeking to the beginning if seekable.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Reads the remaining contents of the stream.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes and detaches the stream resource.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detaches the stream resource without closing it.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the stream if available.

methods.name: isReadable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is readable.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is writable.

methods.name: isSeekable
methods.description: Checks if the stream supports seeking.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the end of the stream has been reached.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Returns the current position of the file pointer.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Rewinds the stream to the beginning.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specific position within the stream.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes from the stream.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves stream metadata or specific metadata entry.
